decisions.why: Three of the four examples are tubular slide sheets for patient transfer.
Cotton balls, HME filters, forceps and gauze swabs are general theatre consumables.
Fit-testing kits, gloves, sleeve covers and dust filters are general PPE.
Examples split between general-purpose syringes and IV/blood giving sets, genuinely spanning both types.
All examples are disposable microfibre mops, cleaning tools and equipment.
Pedal-operated waste bins match washroom and waste management.
Hygiene couch roll is a paper hygiene product.
The example is a maternity delivery/obstetrical kit with umbilical scissors.
Finger dressing, self-seal, low-adherent, is an advanced wound dressing.
